messages:
Ravi Kumar: Starting canary for release v2.8.4 in 2m. Keep an eye on embeds p95/p99 and 5xx. @Sasha @Oncall-SRE
DeployBot: [bot] Canary scheduled: v2.8.4 -> service/inference. canary=5%. commit=aa7c1f3. Commands: /deploybot pin <route>=<ver> | /deploybot rollback <commit> | /deploybot pause <id>
Sasha Li: Running quick preflight now. Will post SLO diff.
ObservabilityBot: Preflight diff (baseline 1h -> canary 10m): embeds p95 baseline=200ms canary=320ms (+60%), embeds p99 baseline=470ms canary=920ms (+96%), 5xx rate baseline=0.04% canary=0.18% (threshold 0.15%). Flagged: embeds breach.
Oncall-SRE: grabbing traces and redis/KMS metrics.
Sasha Li: Traces show increased KMS latency on key unwraps + a small surge of cache misses.
Ravi Kumar: Hold ramp. Options: (A) pin embeds to v2.8.3, (B) full rollback. Prefer A unless SRE advises otherwise.
Oncall-SRE: Recommend route pin first. Lower blast radius. I'll monitor for 15m.
DeployBot: Command received: pin route=embeds -> 2.8.3. Pin applied; canary remains 5% for other routes.
ObservabilityBot: Post-pin snapshot (5m): embeds p95=198ms p99=250ms 5xx=0.05%. Metrics returning to baseline.
Ravi Kumar: Good. Hold pin for 20m. Sasha, add a release note entry and follow-up to adjust KMS client backoff.
Sasha Li: Added note: "canary: embeddings regression traced to KMS latency + cache misses; mitigated via route pin to 2.8.3; follow-up: KMS retry tuning and cache warmup."
DeployBot: Canary paused for embeds. Resume command: /deploybot resume canary-6332101110 after signoff.
Ravi Kumar: Thanks all — will update after 20m.
